reviews.title: Second review as reported for fraud!!!!!!!
reviews.body: Went online for eSIM back in August, lebara had good reviews, looking now I can see they are clearly fake with them all thanking each other by name. I left an honest review based on my experience. The network/ service was terrible in turkey couldn’t use it so put in my review would not recommend nothing bad only honesty, they contacted me and gave a full refund then pestered me via calls and emails for weeks asking me to remove it cause they refunded the cost back to me. Advised I would not as it was a honest review and would not like people to waste their money on purchasing this for marmaris/turkey. 2 month's later I have received an email from trust pilot stating they removed the previous review and lebara have reported  me to them for fraudulent reviews! My review was not fraudulent, the network was terrible. The service was poor, accept it and learn from it. I have emails from lebara confirming they acknowledge it was poor and begging me to remove the post,I have evidence of the refund! if you give poor service expect a poor review and do not report your customers for fraudulent reviews if your service is poor and you do not get the outcome you want. So here I am again leaving my honest review of my experience with this company. I have already sent my emails from them to trust pilot showing g it was genuine and will do again in the future should they wish to falsely report me again! Do not use this company!!

reviews.title: Poor network in Turkey - update
reviews.body:
When I reached the airport the esim would not turn on despite having met all the preconditions of activating Lebara. The network is real patchy at the moment and online app is rubbish which keeps crashing. 
It takes a while for the network to connect so I need to stay near Wifi to contact online support so defeats point of having the esim, even then support read off a script. 
I ordered food in a restaurant and I usually use my google wallet to pay. It was so embarasing when the phone could not conect to Lebara network, I had to walk out and leave the food.
You are better off selecting another network provider as I have used esims in the past that are not this complicated.

---- update on 21/10/2026

Following my review, I have since been contacted by the Lebara team and after hearing my experience they have decided to give a full refund as a good will gesture, which is much appreciated, since I have hardly used the data.

reviews.title: I reached Turkey yesterday and the esim…
reviews.body:
I reached Turkey yesterday and the esim would not work and took ages for the phone to connect to the network despite me following all pre travel instructions. Seem like you need access to WiFi to connect which seems to defeat the objective of having the esim. Even right now the network is patchy. 
I expected to use esim data to contact my driver from airport but I had to use someone else phone to do this.

They keep having to update the online app but no explanation by customer service team. When tried explain over chat my frustration they give standard response 'we are sorry you are experiencing difficulty..' like they are reading off a script. They would not process a refund or discount despite me paying £10 for 12GB. 
They should pay me compensation for the poor network and wasting my time to try and sort the issue. I have came on holiday to enjoy myself not have this headache. 

I would not recommend Lebara, I wished I selected another network as I have used esim in the past and it is usually alot more straightforward.

Updated post 21st Oct 2026
Had a phone call from Kajol in Lebara Trustpilot customer service to apologies and try to rectify the situation I have faced.
She given me a full refund as goodwill gesture so I have reviewed my rating from 1 star to revised 3 star. I hope they can improve the network issue so I can use them in the future.
